experiment: CSC-L8-v1 Phase A2 outcome-blind identifiability probe
folds: exact five source-disjoint folds carried by A1 target archive
target: three T=1 JS semantic-curvature scores per block

features.K: 31-step 17-D causal pose/hand/motion history at the frozen L8 decision arrival, summarized by last/mean/std/last-minus-first (68-D)
features.finger_face: for each of offsets 1/2/3, frozen outer-fold-specific finger66 plus face33 embeddings over frames start-7..start+8, pooled into four nonoverlapping four-frame means (396-D per candidate)
features.projection: one fixed signed feature-hash projection shared across folds and candidates, 396 to 64 dimensions, seed 261110; no outcome fitting
features.normalization: outer-train mean and standard deviation only

model.type: three-output closed-form ridge with unpenalized intercept via centered normalized features and targets

metrics.pooled_r2: 1-SSE/SST over all three scores and all OOF blocks, using outer-train target mean as fold baseline
metrics.winner_accuracy: argmax of three OOF predictions versus argmax target

forbidden: reading robust rewards or continuous terminal advantages
reading reference, WER, future continuation, or true EOS
feature, projection, alpha, threshold, or gate tuning
formal policy OOF before this gate passes
compute: CPU only; no CUDA or nvidia-smi required
